description: The shared @group(0) compute bind group (bindings 0–13) every shader gets from _prelude.wgsl. One contract for both renderers: TS createComputeBindGroupLayout (src/renderer/webgpu/pipeline.ts) builds its layout from this JSON, and the C++ renderer gets the generated wasm_renderer/bind_group0.h. Regenerate with `npm run gen:bind-group0`; `verify:device-policy` fails when the header is stale. Until wasm_renderer/pipeline.cpp includes that header (it needs a pinned-emsdk rebuild of public/wasm/), verify:device-policy checks that its hand-written kComputeBindings table mirrors this JSON binding for binding. sampledColor is format-dependent: 'float' (filterable) unless the internal colour format is rgba32float on a device without float32-filterable. sampledDepth is always unfilterable-float, so shaders must read readDepthTexture with non_filtering_sampler or textureLoad, never u_sampler.

kinds.sampledColor: texture_2d<f32> in the internal colour format
kinds.sampledColorArray: texture_2d_array<f32> in the internal colour format
